notes.title: 🚨New game "Akizora Memories - Horizon of Fate -" Coming Soon 2025🚨
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the English localization of "Akizora Memories - Horizon of Fate -" by GALEX SOFT! Scheduled for early 2025 release! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291862/81ad11a9282db8fa446b36539c48db076199904a.png
◤Synopsis◢
"I want to go back to those days, even if only darkness lies ahead…" 
A young adult SF visual novel combining school life with science fiction. The main characters live normal, peaceful lives, savoring their youth. But one day, an illness starts spreading through their school, and with it, a secret that could change the world…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291862/6bd5dbd9a1821e591d37caf8da279c8c726554b1.png
